test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting facing the centre in a circular position. F is sitting to the immediate right of C. C is sitting at the second position to the right of G. E is sitting at the third position to the right of A. B is an immediate neighbour of both D and E. Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.text: C is sitting at the third position to the right of D.
A is sitting to the immediate left of C.
B is sitting to the immediate right of G.
E is sitting at the third position to the left of G.

solution:
Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting facing the centre in a circular position.

1) F is sitting to the immediate right of C.

2) C is sitting at the second position to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da351bf12aefbef3488abaeb08320b5e3a1f1d936833941fd98e472d9578033c.png] 

3) B is an immediate neighbour of both D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/201104eeaa671b9b7a6d03649e5df4581b58cf3dec3becac2c5f6fd8a1e023dc.png] 

4) E is sitting at the third position to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fb82d80db8369a732b7044bd66f07c98080c317c586f5bcf6628300832579bf.png] 

Now check all the options,

Option (1): C is sitting at the third position to the right of D **→ **True

Option (2): A is sitting to the immediate left of C → True

Option (3): B is sitting to the immediate right of G → False (B is sitting to the immediate right of E)

Option (4): E is sitting at the third position to the left of G → True

Hence, “Option (3)” is the correct answer.
